uncertainties: No scannable QA order, vendor, hub, barcode, or equipment identifier was provided, so result panels and identifier-specific validation messages could not be observed safely.

The business effects of Ready for Delivery, Route Optimized, Driver Out, Ready to optimize, Ready to optimize Bronx, On its way to facility, Manual Back to Pharmacy, Return labels, and Print Stops were not executed because they may mutate business state or trigger printing.
The complete response shapes for getOrderTypes, getOrderActivities, and getHubs were not inspected to avoid copying unnecessary data.
The precise business meaning of the shared getCallProviderSetting request within Scan New was not established.
The initial activity selector exposed only All; context-specific activity choices may require another filter selection or valid business context.
The effects and persistence scope of the header service/context comboboxes were not tested because changing context could affect the authenticated session.
result.summary: ADM Scan New was verified as a shared scanning workspace with 16 observed routes spanning information lookup, printing, filtering, queue validation, and status-related workflows. Shared controls include auto-submit timing, voice/type announcements, hub QR checking, and an announcement settings modal. Scan by Filter loads status, type, activity, and hub metadata, while Ready for Delivery accepts barcode, vendor, or equipment identifiers. Exploration remained read-only and submitted no business identifiers.
